  context={"endpoint"}
>

Define a recurring-payment plan template. `price` must be between
100 and 10_000 and `currency` must be `USD`
(`services/subscriptionService.js:18-29`). Plans are not eligible
for subscriptions until they are published via
`PATCH /api/v1/subscription/plans/{planId}/publish`.
